beats.say: A $5 razor that never stops costing you.
Buy just the handle, no blades.
Buy handle plus a handful of blades.
Buy handle with a blade subscription plan.
First year sales: 51 razors, 168 blades - looks like a mistake.
But it does a job - it forces you to keep buying blades.
The handle costs $5 once, then the real money comes later.
Blades are sold separately, so each shave adds a cost.
In year one the blade count dwarfed the razor count, proving the model works.
Gym: basic entry, premium with unlimited classes, elite with trainer.
Café: single coffee, coffee + pastry, coffee + refill card.
The middle option feels like a smart upgrade, locking future spend.
Watch for a cheap entry product that hides a repeat-purchase hook. Follow for more.
